rationaleBlocks.title: The gap
bullets: Vercel's own marketing page touts **headless CMS integrations** (Contentful, Sanity, Sitecore) — but no Prismic-native ABM layer is in place.
A marketing team of **14 people** supporting 800+ enterprise accounts cannot execute 1:1 LP personalisation without a composable CMS agent layer.
Vercel's site lists CMS as a **plugin concern** for customers, not a solved internal capability — their own marketing pages are likely eng-gated.
The company is in active **enterprise upmarket push** (new CMO from Redis, new COO from Stripe) — ABM readiness is a board-level priority right now.

rationaleBlocks.title: The math
bullets: Rough assumption: **500 tier-1 enterprise targets** in pipeline at any time; current LP coverage is likely 1 generic page per vertical at best.
ABM Agent at Prismic can generate **50+ named-account variants/week** — current eng-gated cadence is likely fewer than 5/month.
A 15% lift in demo bookings from personalised LPs on even **50 named accounts/quarter** at $25K ACV = ~$187K incremental ARR/quarter.
Prismic Enterprise ACV band **€25K–€50K/yr** — payback in under 6 weeks at conservative conversion assumptions.

rationaleBlocks.title: Why now
bullets: Vercel just hired a **CMO (Keith Messick)** — new marketing leadership typically audits the entire campaign and LP infrastructure in the first 90 days.
The enterprise GTM push (WPP partnership, TISAX compliance, Fortune 500 wins) demands **account-specific landing experiences** that a 14-person team cannot hand-build.
Vercel's own **Next.js + Vercel** stack is Prismic's native integration surface — zero infra lift, fastest time-to-value of any prospect in the market.
Competitor pressure from Netlify, Cloudflare Pages means **conversion rate on inbound enterprise traffic** is a direct revenue lever.

rationaleBlocks.title: What Prismic Agents ship
bullets: **ABM Agent**: reverse-IP detects named accounts, serves a personalised LP variant in real time — no engineer required.
**SEO Agent**: audits and regenerates thin solution/use-case pages; Vercel's /solutions/* pages are a clear target surface.
**Localization Agent**: Vercel operates globally; EN-only LP coverage leaves EMEA and APAC enterprise pipeline under-served.
**Paid Ads Agent**: matches every outbound ad creative to a dedicated post-click LP — closes the message-match gap on paid campaigns.

quickWins.text: **Book** a Prismic demo with Vercel's new CMO (Keith Messick) team within 7 days — reference their Next.js-native integration and the 90-day new-CMO audit window as the hook; **measure** meeting acceptance rate.

**Build** a live Prismic ABM demo page at prismic.io/for/vercel using their own brand tokens and a Next.js Slice Machine setup — serve it on reverse-IP detection when vercel.com IPs hit Prismic.io; **watch** time-on-page vs. generic homepage.

**Audit** Vercel's /solutions/* and /customers/* pages for thin content and missing keyword clusters — present the SEO Agent output as a 3-slide gap analysis in the discovery call; **track** estimated monthly organic opportunity in EUR.

**Run** a LinkedIn Sponsored Content sequence targeting 'Marketing' + 'Growth' titles at Vercel (company-targeted) with the message 'Your Next.js stack already works with Prismic — your marketers just don't know it yet'; **measure** CTR and demo requests.

**Propose** a Prismic + Vercel co-marketing webinar on 'ABM at Edge speed for Next.js teams' — Vercel's developer audience is Prismic's ICP; **measure** co-branded MQL volume and pipeline influenced within 60 days.
